subject: Coord: Marketplace partner + GSI technical deep-dive — scheduling
messages:
From: Amy Jenkins <amy.jenkins@prismtech.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cloudwave Partnerships <partners@cloudwave.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@cloudwave.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from intro — next steps to schedule technical deep-dive

Thanks again for the intro call this morning, Rafael. Great to see alignment between PrismTech and Cloudwave on a potential marketplace listing and joint GTM. As discussed, the next step is a technical deep-dive so our GSI architecture team can validate integration points and call routing for the marketplace flow.

High-level asks from PrismTech for the deep-dive:
- Overview of your marketplace integration endpoints and auth model
- Expected latency and token accounting for routed calls
- Any deployment constraints for Dedicated/Private models

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 10/14, 10:00–11:00am
- Thu 10/15, 2:00–3:00pm
- Fri 10/16, 9:00–10:00am

Can you confirm which of the slots works and who from Redwood should join (architect + product ideally)? Also attaching a short checklist we use for marketplace onboards.

Cheers,
Amy Jenkins
Principal Solutions Architect, PrismTech
amy.jenkins@prismtech.com
--- Attachment: PrismTech-Onboard-Checklist.pdf (stub)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Jenkins <amy.jenkins@prismtech.com>, Cloudwave Partnerships <partners@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from intro — next steps to schedule technical deep-dive

Amy — thanks for the clear summary and the proposed windows. Appreciate the checklist.

Quick recap from our side (so everyone has the same view):
- Goal: 60–90m technical deep-dive covering marketplace routing, auth, error/fallback behavior, and performance expectations.
- Must-haves on our side: someone from infra/runtime (Sergio) and product integration (Camila). Vanessa will cover contracting/marketplace requirements.

I can confirm the Wed 10/14 10:00–11:00am PT slot for a 60-minute session. Sergio and Camila — can you both commit to that slot? If not, the Thu 2:00–3:00pm PT backup also works.

Proposed agenda (brief):
1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) Marketplace flow: auth and routing (15m)
3) Runtime behavior: latency, batching, KV cache (20m)
4) Failure modes & fallback policy (10m)
5) Integration checklist & next actions (10m)

Attachments: Redwood-Marketplace-Onboarding-Checklist.pdf (attached).

Also linking a short calendar availability page: https://cal.com/redwood/tech-deep-dive — feel free to pick a time if these windows don't align.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Lead, Strategic Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai

Rafael — confirmed. I can make Wed 10/14 10:00am PT and will be the primary runtime/infra contact.
Camila — can you handle the integration/contracting piece and own the marketplace auth details? Vanessa — if we need to surface contractual constraints or marketplace timetables, can you please have the relevant docs ready?

I'll put together a short tech agenda and attach an initial doc with the surface-level integration points I'm planning to cover.

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

All — confirmed for Wed 10/14 10:00–11:00am PT. Thanks for pulling this together.

A few quick notes ahead of the call:
- I'll cover the auth model end-to-end and the marketplace token exchange flow.
- Please be prepared to share any SSO/KMS constraints if PrismTech requires on-prem HSMs — that will determine whether we route to Private vs. Dedicated options.
- Vanessa, I uploaded the marketplace terms summary to the shared drive: https://redwood.gdrive/link/marketplace-onboard (commented).

I'll bring a short slide with the integration diagram and sequence flow; Sergio will handle latency numbers and known corner cases. Amy — if you have any particular API endpoints or test data you want us to run through, send it over before EOD Tuesday.

—Camila
